mapper.select: SELECT 'CUSTOMER' AS biz_type, id AS biz_id, company_name AS display_name, updater AS deleted_by, update_time AS deleted_time FROM lunaerp_baseinfo_customer WHERE deleted = 1 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY update_time DESC

SELECT ( (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_business_sales_contract WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_business_shipment WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_production_dyeing_order WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) + (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM lunaerp_sample_analysis WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}) )
